subject: MAP: deployment route & sprint commitment — hosted PoC then dedicated evaluation
messages:
From: Lisa Thompson <lisa.thompson@horizonhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@horizonhealth.com, eng@horizonhealth.com
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Start MAP: deployment route + timeline questions

Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our leadership asked for a short mutual action plan (MAP) focused on two things: 1) an evaluation PoC timeline that shows how quickly we can validate correctness and latency across Hosted vs Dedicated, and 2) a recommended path if we need EU data residency for a subset of traffic.

High level asks from our side:
- Hosted PoC first (fastest path) to validate model quality + prefix caching behavior for our clinical prompts.
- If Hosted doesn't meet latency or data residency requirements, we want a clear next step to Dedicated or Private, with estimated lead times and cost delta.
- A procurement timeline (legal + procurement) — our procurement team needs an estimate for DocuSign/terms.

Can you send a MAP draft and a proposed 2–4 week sprint plan for the PoC? We have a three-person engineering team ready to partner on the PoC.

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Thompson
Director, Platform Engineering | Horizon Health
[Attachment: Horizon_MAP_Request.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Lisa Thompson <lisa.thompson@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, procure@horizonhealth.com
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Start MAP: deployment route + timeline questions

Lisa —

Appreciate the clear ask. I've sketched a working MAP and an evaluation sprint that aligns with your idea of Hosted-first with a deterministic escape to Dedicated/Private. See the draft attached (Horizon_MAP_Draft_v1). High-level summary below:

Proposed MAP (summary)
- Week 0: Kickoff + access (API keys, test datasets, compliance checklist)
- Week 1: Hosted PoC — integrate & validate model outputs on clinical prompt set; measure p50/p95 latency and token-cost; smoke test KV/prefix cache behavior
- Week 2: Load & regression tests; if latency > target or residency block -> trigger Dedicated eval
- Week 3-4: Dedicated capacity estimate + small canary on dedicated pool (if triggered)

Key open items for us:
- Data residency scope (subset of traffic vs whole org) — affects timeline for Private/VPC options
- SLA targets you want for p95 latency and throughput
- Any specific compliance evidence needed (SOC2 artifacts, audit log snippets) — we can include sample audit logs in the MAP package

Attachments included:
- Horizon_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (draft MAP and sprint checklist)

Next steps: can we lock a kickoff for this Thursday 10am ET? I can run the kickoff and Marissa will join for SLA/ops gating.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Horizon_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Lisa Thompson <lisa.thompson@horizonhealth.com>, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Start MAP: deployment route + timeline questions

Quick notes from ops perspective — copying what I plan to bring to kickoff: 

- SLA & fallback policy: define p95 target (suggest 300ms for inference non-batched; higher allowed for batched scenarios). If Hosted p95 > 500ms during PoC, auto-trigger Dedicated eval.
- Canary policy: 100 qps sustained for 15 minutes with traffic split 90/10 hosted/dedicated during canary.
- Security artifacts: we'll provide SOC2 Type II report extract + sample audit log for token-level tracing. Procurement might request additional encryption attestations; bring KMS/HSM doc if needed.

I'll add these to the MAP and bring the ops checklist.

Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Lisa Thompson <lisa.thompson@horizonhealth.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Start MAP: deployment route + timeline questions

Lisa —

I attached an evaluation checklist that maps concrete test cases to pass/fail criteria for Hosted vs Dedicated. Key items:
- Functional quality: 500 prompt seeds across representative clinical templates; acceptance threshold: >= 95% label agreement with your SME review sample.
- Latency: p50/p95 and cold-start metrics; warm-up window length documented.
- Cost delta: per-1M token delta between Hosted baseline and small Dedicated pool (we included a conservative quantized config).
- Geofence test: validation plan to assert EU residency for the capped subset of traffic.

Please review the checklist and mark any items that must be changed for regulatory reasons.

Attachment: eval-checklist-hosted-to-dedicated.xlsx (spreadsheet)

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Lisa Thompson <lisa.thompson@horizonhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@horizonhealth.com, eng@horizonhealth.com
Date: Thu, 24 Dec 2026 10:37:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Start MAP: deployment route + timeline questions

Thanks — this looks good. A few clarifications from procurement/engineering: 

- Data residency: we need EU residency for any patient-identifiable inference (about 15% of calls). The rest can remain US-hosted. That means the MAP should include a geofencing path and timeline to stand up an EU-dedicated pool or private VPC option.
- Procurement: target signing window is 2–3 weeks after final MAP if PoC looks good. We'll route redlines through our procurement. DocuSign link will be requested by Friday if we can get final SOW numbers.

On timeline: what does "Week 2: trigger Dedicated eval" look like in calendar days? Can you confirm realistic lead times for Dedicated (e.g., how long to reserve a small pool and get it live for canary)?

Lisa

Subject: Re: Start MAP: deployment route + timeline questions — confirmed sprint & canary cadence

Lisa / team —

Thanks for the clarifications. Finalizing MAP and sprint commitments below (this is the version we'll use for kickoff on Thursday):

Agreed MAP (finalized)
- Kickoff: Thu, 2026-12-31 10:00 AM ET (30m) — scope, keys, test dataset handoff
- Hosted PoC (2 weeks): 2027-01-03 -> 2027-01-14
  - Deliverables: integration checklist complete, 500-seed SME evaluation, latency/cost report, prefix cache behavior notes
  - Pass criteria: SME agreement >= 95% AND p95 latency <= 350ms for representative test set
- Trigger window: if Hosted pass criteria fails during week of 2027-01-10, we will move to Dedicated eval immediately.
- Dedicated canary (if triggered): provision small Dedicated pool (~1-2 GPUs equivalent) and run 72-hour canary across EU subset. Estimated lead time to provision & give you access: 5 business days from trigger.
- Private / VPC: if dedicated canary shows security/residency gaps, we have a Private on-prem/VPC option — estimated 4–6 week lead time for assembly and security onboarding.

Procurement & contractual notes
- We'll provide a SOW + conservative cost estimate for Dedicated by 2027-01-07. See attached cost-estimate-dedicated-2026-12.pdf.
- HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567 — I pushed the MAP as a note.
- DocuSign: we'll prepare a draft SOW for signature once the SOW numbers are agreed. Procurement team, expect a DocuSign link w/ SOW by Friday (2027-01-07) if PoC metrics align.

Attachments
- Horizon_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (updated with SLA/pass criteria)
- eval-checklist-hosted-to-dedicated.xlsx
- cost-estimate-dedicated-2026-12.pdf

Action items (owners)
- Horizon: confirm kickoff attendees + share test dataset by 2026-12-30 (Lisa)
- Redwood: finalize SOW numbers and cost sheet by 2027-01-07 (Karthik / Marissa)
- Redwood Ops: standby to provision Dedicated pool within 5 business days of trigger (Marissa)

If that looks good I'll lock the kickoff calendar invite. Happy to iterate on the canary parameters if you want a longer or shorter validation window.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
[Attachments: Horizon_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf, eval-checklist-hosted-to-dedicated.xlsx, cost-estimate-dedicated-2026-12.pdf]
